title: Music Disc Funk
description: Replaces Minecraft music discs with custom rap & funk album covers and matching songs.
body:
# Music Disc Funk

**Music Disc Funk** replaces every Minecraft music disc with a custom album cover and a matching rap, funk, phonk, or hip-hop track, giving your world a completely new soundtrack.
![all the disc in the pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbfbb22a37814573b7c049975b6b37cecbb081e1.png)
## Included Tracks

* NLE Choppa – Final Warning
* Blackedy – throwing me off
* B67 – OATS
* The Rare Occasions – Notion
* PHONK 47 – Estilo Horizonte Diamante
* Clovis Reyes – Hikari (Slowed + Reverb)
* King Von – Took Her To The O (Audiomack Fine Tuned Version)
* Steve Lacy – Bad Habit
* d4vd – Feel It
* KIXIA, KREZUS & Mc Kaique SP – HOMAGE FUNK
* zarzour – MENTIRAO
* neverbadagain – fly day chinatown (hoodtrap)
* Prey, Emrld!, KGJ & Regyn – DEAD WORONG FUNK
* neverbadagain – telepatia (afrobeats Slowed)

Enjoy a fresh music experience while exploring, building, or relaxing in Minecraft.
